source: Onkelos on Exod 40:1-8; the command's date at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:11; the completion dispute at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:12; the scheduling at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:13
claim_en: On the first day of the first month — the placement program in dependency order, inside outward: ark, veil over it, table set in order, lampstand lit, gold altar before the ark, screens, offering altar, laver WITH WATER, court (Onkelos Exod 40). The spine dates both ends: the COMMAND was given on the Day of Atonement — the 120 days of the three ascents ending at I-HAVE-PARDONED (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:11 — EX34-03's calendar quoted back at the erection); the completion disputed — three months to Kislev then folded till Nisan (R. Samuel bar Nachman) or done by the first of Adar at the winter labor-rate (R. Chanina) (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:12); and the delay decoded as SCHEDULING: joy mingled with joy — erected on Isaac's birthday, the scoffers not knowing the scheduler's intent (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:13). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

Aaron immersed, dressed, anointed, sanctified TO SERVE BEFORE ME; the sons after him — and the charter line: their anointing an ETERNAL PRIESTHOOD FOR THEIR GENERATIONS (Onkelos Exod 40): the investiture of EX29 closed out with a perpetuity clause on the office itself.

source: Onkelos on Exod 40:16-18; the reserved step at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:7 with 11:8; the self-standing at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 8:1 with 8:2
claim_en: In the first month of the SECOND year, on day one, the tabernacle WAS RAISED — the passive — and Moses RAISED it — the active, side by side (Onkelos Exod 40). The spine reads the verb-triple as the division of labor: 'BUSY YOUR HANDS with it — you will appear to raise it, IT WILL RISE OF ITSELF, and I write that you raised it' — the step reserved for the one man who had no share in the making (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:7); the drill-count dispute rides — dismantled and re-erected twice daily or three times through the investiture week, counted from the verb-forms (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:8). The Buber recension states it at the crown: each came crying here-is-my-hook, my-board, my-bolt; none could raise it; the tabernacle rose of itself — and even the Temple after it stands only when the LORD builds the house (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 8:1); the daughter-sister-mother ladder rides on the crown-verse with its written-form claim — MY-NATION written readable as MY-MOTHER (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 8:2). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 40:19-29; the docket row Mishnah Shabbat 2:3
claim_en: He spread THE TENT over the tabernacle — the flax-and-tent lexicon the case shelf's wick-law reads from this verse (Mishnah Shabbat 2:3, this exam's docket) — the Testimony into the ark, the bread SET IN ORDER, the lamps LIT, the incense BURNED, the burnt-offering and meal-offering OFFERED (Onkelos Exod 40): Moses himself running every service in the erection week — the acting priest before the priests; each stage sealed as-the-LORD-commanded-Moses, the countersignature refrain riding down the whole install.

Water in the laver FOR SANCTIFICATION; Moses, Aaron, and his sons WOULD SANCTIFY their hands and feet at every entry and approach (Onkelos Exod 40) — the wash-verb converted to the consecration-verb throughout, EX30-05's translation-law confirmed in execution.

source: Onkelos on Exod 40:34-38; the descent ladder at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 6:2; the landing at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:14; the compression at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:2; the colophon at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 8:9
claim_en: The cloud covered the Tent and the GLORY of the LORD FILLED the tabernacle — and Moses, whose hands raised it, COULD NOT ENTER: full is full (Onkelos Exod 40) — the cave-and-sea compression proven at its landing verse (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 7:2). The spine computes the trajectory: the Presence's home was below; SEVEN sins drove it up through the seven firmaments, SEVEN righteous drew it back — Abraham to Amram, and MOSES, on the day the tabernacle rose, landed it (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 6:2); the moment it stood, the Presence descended — and the promise forward: in the world to come it never departs (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:14). EX25-01's I-will-dwell discharged at the last chapter; the cloud-by-day and VISION-of-fire-by-night before all the house of Israel IN ALL THEIR JOURNEYS — the travel-signal protocol left running as the book ends, the spine's own colophon on the sitting: the End of the Book of Exodus (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 8:9). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.
